# Svatební galerie – Pavel Prokeš

> Private online wedding galleries by Pavel Prokeš, a wedding photographer based in Prague, Czech Republic. Couples and their guests open a gallery from a link or QR code, view and download the photos and the photographer's videos, and — when the couple allows it — add their own photos from the wedding. The public pages are a short help page and a step-by-step guide, both in seven languages: Czech, English, French, German, Spanish, Slovak and Polish.

Gallery contents are private: every gallery is reached only through its own link, sometimes with a password, and is not listed or indexed. Questions about booking, prices or the photographer's work belong to the main site.

## Help

- [Wedding gallery help](https://photos.svatebni-fotograf-cechy.cz/): where to get the gallery link or QR code, what to do without the password, why a link stops working, offline viewing, downloading everything at once, videos for social media and the gallery's languages.
- [Step-by-step guide](https://photos.svatebni-fotograf-cechy.cz/guide) (Czech: [/navod](https://photos.svatebni-fotograf-cechy.cz/navod); also /guide/de, /guide/fr, /guide/es, /guide/sk, /guide/pl): opening the gallery for the first time, browsing, choosing photos for print, favourites, downloading, asking for a retouch, guest uploads, offline viewing, privacy and troubleshooting.

## Free tool

- [Video ze svatebních fotek](https://photos.svatebni-fotograf-cechy.cz/video-z-fotek) (Czech): a free slideshow maker. Anyone adds 3 to 60 photos (JPEG, PNG or WebP) and downloads an MP4 without sound: vertical 9:16 (1080 × 1920) for Instagram Reels, Stories and TikTok, or landscape 16:9 (1920 × 1080) for YouTube. Every photo is in the video; the length follows the number of photos and a calm or dynamic pace. It runs entirely in the browser: the photos are not uploaded or stored anywhere. No account and no watermark. Works best in a current Chrome, Edge or Safari.

## What a gallery offers

- One link, nothing to install: it opens in a normal browser on a phone or a computer, without an account.
- Download the whole gallery as one ZIP, the photographer's videos included.
- Share a single photo: a button in the full-screen view sends a link that opens on that photo, and the message preview shows it.
- The photographer's films play right in the gallery.
- A short video for social media, made by the photographer from the gallery's photos and included in every package, in both versions: vertical 9:16 for Instagram Stories, Reels and TikTok, and landscape 16:9 for YouTube and websites, 15 or 30 seconds. Both are in the gallery for download. They have no sound and no captions; music is added in the social app.
- Photos from guests: guests scan a QR code and add their own photos, without an app or an account. Guests upload photos only, not videos. GPS location is removed from guests' photos before they are sent.
- Live slideshow at the wedding: new guest photos appear on the screen within about half a minute.
- Favorites and reactions, a print selection with the number of copies, and a one-time code to carry them over to another device.
- Best of the day and chapters (ceremony, reception…) when the photographer turns them on.
- Offline mode: a gallery saved once stays viewable without signal.
- Several galleries under one wedding link that grows over time: guest photos on the night, a first selection, then the full set.
- Seven languages, chosen from the phone's settings and switchable in the footer. Gallery titles and descriptions are the photographer's own text and may stay in Czech.

## Key facts

- A gallery never expires on its own. A link stops working only if the photographer gives it a time limit or turns it off.
- After five wrong password attempts the link locks for 15 minutes for everyone who has it. Only the photographer knows the password.
- "Download all" gives the whole gallery as one ZIP, usually ready within an hour of the last upload (it waits for uploads to settle, then builds in the background). Until then photos can be downloaded one by one.
